title: Rain and wonders
text: Juanjo is the name of the guide who welcomed us and joined us for a walk together around Seville, while providing us of a true local view of the city. Connecting us with more than 2000 years of wars, myths and street stories, Juanjo did not tell us the story of Seville, but instead, he just had a friendly and relaxed chat with us, which provided us of the right balance between history and contemporary way of living. After 2 hours, it is easy to realise that Seville is a beautiful city itself, Juanjo provides the insights and the the necessary context to appreciate the city through the eyes of
author: 323efraimt

title: Seville in the Summer!
text: Juan was a fabulous guide in Seville.   He covered all the high points with perfect amount of detail.  He was witty, sharp and adorable.   We were with our 22 year old son and girlfriend and were all on the same level.  He also gave us great recommendations for eating and drinking post tour!  Well done Juan!   We wish you much success and thank you!
author: 794kristink

title: It was great. I recommended 100%
text: Our tour guide was the best. Lots of knowledge!!! We appreciated that he was really patience with grandma and wasn't pushing for the time as sometimes happen. It was the best tour we could take in Seville. 100% a plus
author: Carmen_M

title: Pleasant and efficient introduction to the city's major attractions.
text: It was the first tour of Seville, the very first day after late arrival the day before.  Juan (sorry if spelling is wrong) was already at the plaza -ready to help us explore the city. He impressed us with his knowledge of history, art, architecture and the manner in which he presented the Seville's beauty. It was exactly the type of introduction to the city that I wanted from this tour. Important observation about Juan:- he was polite and tolerant of our 7-years-old son's behavior. I can't say it was the case with all tour guides I've experienced in the past.
author: Natacha_M
